references.text: The plan for the ambush was laid earlier in the chapter, where Joshua instructed the men to lie in wait behind the city
Joshua gave the command to set the city on fire, which was fulfilled in verse 19
Joshua stretched out his spear toward Ai as a signal, and this triggered the attack by the ambush force in verse 19
A similar conquest pattern at Jericho where the people stormed the city after a divine signal
A parallel strategy with an ambush against Gibeah, where the ambush force stormed and set the city on fire
The smoke from the burning city was a sign, a situation similar to that at Ai
